Fixes the SudoClaude app not opening. The 1.0.0 Flatpak was missing a library Qt needs (Kerberos), so it quit right away with an import error. The bundle now includes it, and the build checks that Qt loads so this can't ship broken again.

If you installed 1.0.0, install this one over it:

```sh
flatpak install --user SudoClaude.flatpak
```
